feature: Add Bulk QR Code Download for All Tables
workflow_rationale: This is a feature addition that extends existing QR download functionality to support bulk operations. It follows a clear dependency order: install dependencies → create utilities → integrate UI → verify functionality.

phases.description: Install JSZip library for creating ZIP files in the browser

subtasks.description: Install JSZip package for ZIP file creation
subtasks.notes: Successfully added jszip@^3.10.1 and @types/jszip@^3.4.1 to package.json. User needs to run 'npm install' to install the dependencies before proceeding to next phase.

phases.name: Bulk Download Utilities
phases.description: Create bulk QR download utility functions for generating ZIP and combined PDF

subtasks.notes: Successfully created lib/qrcode/bulk-download.ts with downloadAllTablesAsZip and downloadAllTablesAsPDF functions. Implemented comprehensive error handling, TypeScript types, and JSDoc documentation following the patterns from generator.ts and limits.ts. Committed in 35c4b18.

phases.name: End-to-End Verification
phases.description: Verify bulk download functionality works correctly for all formats

subtasks.description: Manual testing of bulk QR download feature

verification.instructions: 1. Navigate to tables page with multiple tables. 2. Click 'Download All' button. 3. Select 'Download All as ZIP' - verify ZIP downloads with correct file names. 4. Select 'Download All as PDF' - verify PDF downloads with all table QR codes. 5. Test with 0 tables, 1 table, and 10+ tables. 6. Verify error handling when QR generation fails.
